recognize_zh: 八格組圖中的紅血球系前驅細胞（深藍色細胞質、圓核、細顆粒染色質的原紅血球母細胞到較小的晚期紅血球母細胞）邊緣出現許多細小棘狀突起、偽足或小泡狀外突，使細胞輪廓變形，這是 HHV-6 相關幼兒暫時性紅血球母細胞減少症所描述的紅血球母細胞變形。
features: Panels A-B: large proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm, round nuclei, finely granular chromatin and small cytoplasmic blebs at the margin
Panels C, E-G: basophilic erythroblasts with irregular outlines bearing multiple fine spiky or filamentous cytoplasmic projections and pseudopods
Panel G: two adjacent erythroblasts with circumferential hair-like projections
Panels D and H: smaller, later-stage erythroblasts with condensed chromatin and irregular, tailed cytoplasmic outlines
Background of normocytic red cells and occasional neutrophils; cells are cropped, so overall erythroid quantity cannot be judged
describe_en: Composite of cropped cells (A-H) from a Wright-Giemsa-stained smear shows erythroid precursors ranging from proerythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and finely granular chromatin to smaller late erythroblasts with condensed chromatin. Many of these cells display marked cytoplasmic deformation with blebs, pseudopods and fine spiky or filamentous projections around the cell margin. The images do not allow assessment of overall erythroid cellularity or of viral inclusions. In the setting of HHV-6 infection with reticulocytopenia in a young child, findings are consistent with the deformed erythroblasts described in transient erythroblastopenia of childhood.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19-associated pure red cell aplasia
ddx.vs: Shows giant proerythroblasts with glassy intranuclear inclusions and vacuolated cytoplasm with 'dog-ear' projections, whereas TEC erythroblasts lack giant forms and nuclear inclusions.
Presents in infancy with macrocytosis, elevated fetal hemoglobin and eADA, congenital anomalies and ribosomal protein gene mutations, without spontaneous recovery.
Consists of sheets of pronormoblasts with vacuoles and TP53 mutation, rather than scattered reactive erythroblasts in a self-limited childhood anemia.
Megakaryoblasts also show cytoplasmic blebs but express CD41/CD61, and lymphoblasts have scant pale cytoplasm; erythroblasts here are CD71/glycophorin/E-cadherin lineage.
